note: Concessionaire-run campground on the south side of Inyo County's Millpond Recreation Area off Sawmill Rd, ~6 mi NW of Bishop; reach it through the park. Site rows line both sides of tree-shaded McGee Creek. The park beside it has a swim pond (no power boats), disc golf, archery, tennis, ball fields and a playground. --Claude
summary: Operator page, map, ResNexus and county pages read: open Mar 1-Oct 31, 72 sites (19 x 30 A + water, rest dry), ResNexus/phone booking opening Mar 1, showers/laundry/flush toilets. NO RATE FOUND (county defers to the concessionaire; ResNexus shows no 2027 prices). Pin is in the pond - move ~660 m. Possible creekside (for AWH).
flags: RATE: still unknown. Inyo County says the concessionaire sets the fee; the operator page and map post none; ResNexus listed every class 'OCCUPIED' with no price for Jun 9-10 2027 (season bookings open March 1). Wayback has no rate page. Price gate does not apply (local ownership).

PIN: stored 37.37980,-118.49450 is in the Millpond swim pond (day-use park, north end). The campground is the site strip ~650 m south; suggest 37.37405,-118.49265 (centre of the rows; ~660 m move; 3DEP ~1361 m vs stored 1350 m). The stored waterfront_evidence describes the pond surroundings, not the campground.

WATERFRONT: stored 'not waterfront' (not --AWH). POSSIBLE 'creekside' - AWH's call, since the water itself is under canopy. The operator's site map draws McGee Creek running between the two site columns of every block, with footbridges (sites 21-36 | 1A-13, 37-54 | 14-20 + 55-64, 65-72 back onto it), and the operator page says the sites are 'backed by the cool-running waters of a creek'. Imagery shows the RV rows at both edges of a 20-30 m riparian tree belt with no road or day-use strip between, and 3DEP is flat (a ~1 m channel dip, so an easy walk to the water). Satellite can't see the creek, though, and the map is the operator's own drawing. All sites are sold by the night (ResNexus). Proposed evidence if upgraded: 'Operator site map (2020) + Esri + 3DEP 2026-11-27: McGee Creek runs between the site columns of every block (21-36|1A-13, 37-54|14-20/55-64, 65-72), footbridges across; rows sit at the edges of a 20-30 m riparian tree belt with nothing between; ground flat (~1 m channel dip); creek width under canopy not measurable.' If not upgraded, the evidence should be rewritten for the campground strip rather than the pond.

FIT: 'Camping spaces available for larger RV's' (county); ResNexus filters rig lengths 20+ to 45+ ft; one class is 'No Pop outs'. The stored max_rig_ft 54 came from note prose and is not posted on any current page - consider clearing it (left unwritten here).
